start_here: Say to your AI: "Copy /Shared/clips/clip-1080p.mp4 into the Google Drive folder 1AbCdEfGh my friend shared with me." It shares the file to itself for an hour, runs tool:copy-a-file-into-a-storage-place with that link, and hands back the new file's id, or says plainly that you may not add files to that folder.
no_lists_because: It keeps no list: it copies one file and answers what the storage place made.
instructions: 1. Make an address the copy can read the file from: share_file the file (tool:your-files) for an hour and keep its url and byte_length.

2. Run tool:copy-a-file-into-a-storage-place with from {url, byte_length}, to {place: google-drive, folder: the folder's id, name, media_type} and via (composio with account, or google-account with connection).

3. Read copied: true with the new file's id, or copied: false with said, such as "You may not add files to \"ATX\" in Google Drive"; then ask the folder's owner to give you the right to add, or copy into a folder of your own.
4. Stop the hour's share with stop_share when the copy is done.

worked_examples.title: A clip copied into a Drive folder by pieces
worked_examples.ask: Copy clip.mp4 into my Drive folder f1.
worked_examples.given: From test/copy-a-file-into-a-storage-place.test.mjs: a 700000-byte file and a folder the account may add to, sent in pieces of 262144 bytes.
worked_examples.hands_back: {"copied":true,"folder":"Clips for Ana","name":"clip.mp4","id":"new-file-id","byte_length":700000,"pieces":3,"said":"Copied clip.mp4 (700000 bytes) into \"Clips for Ana\" in Google Drive."}

worked_examples.title: A folder shared with view rights only
worked_examples.ask: Put clip.mp4 in the folder my friend shared.
worked_examples.given: The folder answers canAddChildren false for this account.
worked_examples.hands_back: {"copied":false,"folder":"Clips for Ana","said":"You may not add files to \"Clips for Ana\" in Google Drive: its owner has not given this account the right to add to it. Nothing was copied."}
